description: Reads the STANDARD, not your file. Extract normative requirements (shall/must/may) from the PDF specification (ISO 32000-2). Returns structured requirements with the sentence context, section, and requirement level. It tells you what the specification requires, never whether a given PDF satisfies it — to check a file, use pdf-verify-mcp (validate_conformance / evaluate_policy).

level.description: Filter by requirement level (shall, shall not, should, should not, may).

section.description: Limit to this section and its subsections.

spec.description: Spec ID (e.g. "iso32000-2", "pdf17"). Omit for the default spec.

name: get_requirements
title: Extract normative requirements
